d.ko: RotM is an Action Roguelite FPS game where players get in the robes of a Mage. Let the hands of fate open ways for the power of your magic. Save the Multiverse to power up yourself! Unlock, collect, discover, live, die, repeat!

d.zh: RotM 是一款动作类 Roguelite FPS 游戏，玩家将化身为一名法师。让命运之手为你的魔法力量开辟道路！拯救多元宇宙，增强自身实力！解锁、收集、探索、生存、死亡、重复
